summary: Eleventh independent adversarial pass over the full cast/party diff. Verified build, tsc, 812 vitest tests, eslint and npm run audit, and confirmed the one Go failure (TestCreateSession_VideoCodecOutClamp) reproduces on main (no ffmpeg in this container). Mechanically compared the extracted decideHostBroadcast against the pre-extraction inline host poll across the full input cross-product: zero divergences in broadcast action and baseline disposition; the sole difference was the latch side-effect, fixed here (L1). Also checked unit correctness at every receiver-clock read, the nullable anchor, the epoch check, castLoadsInFlightRef pairing, the ?at=/start_sec server contract and CLAUDE.md's claims individually. No critical, high or medium findings; verdict was merge, taking L1 and L5. L1 (latch on guarded polls) and L5 (a test asserting a variation it could not exercise) are fixed; L2 (omitted start_sec falls back to the local anchor), L3 (anchorUnknown is a one-way input) and L4 (the warm-up mirror's own command read as the user's a poll later) are recorded in CLAUDE.md's known-limits list as follow-ups.
